I have been a member at Fitness First, Inspire, BKC for the last 6 months and I regret to inform that it's hasn't been a pleasant experience for me.

Furthermore, my PT instructor was changed without any prior consent, discussion or notice without any proper handover. This was alarming for me.

Furthermore, the hard sales tactics have just left me speechless since the day my PT and membership is coming to an end. On communicating multiple times that I am unable to give a definitive answer, I was approached multiple times in the same week.

Moreove, lack of equal opportunity to clients to change the PT schedule, trainers often give priority to old clients, high paying clients or someone who has booked more sessions.

Fitness First is one of the premium fitness centres of the city and is surprisingly managed as one of the local gyms.

I sincerely hope these practices won't put your brand at risk.

He has told me that he is calling me just for assessment, then I can join the gym anytime as per my convenience. I have visited and met Mr. Christie. However, it became clear that the sessions I was told for assessment by Mr. Christie were actually conducted to convince me to opt for personal training. I cannot afford the personal training offer of Mr. Christie. After that I tried to continue the gym session and visited gym 3-4 times, however, due to aforementioned office commitments and my health issues I could not visit the gym till date.

featured_reviews.name: Kinjal Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a very disappointing experience at Impulse Studio. I paid for a trial Zumba class scheduled at 10:00 AM. When I arrived, there was no teacher and no students present. The person at reception mentioned that the class usually starts at 10:15, which was different from the time communicated to me.

When I contacted Bosky to clarify, instead of addressing the confusion politely, she was extremely aggressive and rude. I simply mentioned that it was 10:05 AM and no one was there.

As a client-facing business in the fitness industry, basic courtesy and professionalism are expected.

Very disappointed with how this was handled.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We’re genuinely sorry that your experience didn’t match your expectations—but a little perspective might help balance the narrative.
At 10:02 AM—barely two minutes past the scheduled time—we received a rather urgent demand for a refund, despite the session being clearly non-refundable. In a city like Mumbai, where even trains allow for a minute’s grace before declaring a delay, expecting a full class to be in motion at the exact second is, perhaps, a touch optimistic.
Our class began at 10:15 AM, which is well within the natural rhythm of how group sessions ease into momentum. Fitness, after all, is not instant noodles—it requires a little patience before the magic begins.
Despite this, we still chose to refund your amount as a gesture of goodwill, not obligation—simply to ensure there was no lingering unpleasantness. Ironically, that courtesy seems to have gone unacknowledged.
As for the interaction with Bosky, we did review the exchange. While we always stand for professionalism, we also believe respect is a two-way street. Conversations, much like workouts, tend to go better when they don’t begin at full intensity.
Impulse Studio isn’t built for hurried check-ins and stopwatch exits—it’s built for people who value the process, the energy, and the experience of showing up for themselves.
That said, we sincerely wish you the best in your fitness journey—and perhaps, along the way, the discovery that the first step to fitness isn’t speed, but composure.

I have known Shivani for the last 7 years and have trained with her during this entire journey. What truly sets her apart is her holistic approach to pain management and healing, not just exercise.

I had severe sciatica pain to the extent that I couldn’t walk. With her guidance, awareness-based training, and consistent work, the pain has now reduced to once in a while. featured_reviews.review_text:
Training with Shivani and Pranay has been a game-changer for me. What sets them apart is how personal and intelligent their approach to fitness is. They don’t just make you sweat - they make you understand your body, your movements, and your limits, and then help you go beyond them safely.

Her inputs not just help in improving physical health but overall mental health too. She meets you at your pace - never rushed, always encouraging, and always precise.

Never thought I’d look forward to every session or feel guilty for missing one. If you’re looking for trainers who truly get it - who care, who adapt, and who push you the right way, then Sculptasse is the right place.
